note: This file is the record the roadmap asks for: 'Registrar exatamente gateway, versão, modo e cenário testados. Não prometer compatibilidade com todos os gateways.'

It is a record of what was OBSERVED and not a list of intentions. A row that names no tested scenario is not a homologation, whatever mode it declares, and PaymentMatrix::decision() answers 'undecided' for it — which is the machine-readable form of 'we promise nothing about this gateway'.
Every gateway of the store appears here, including the ones with no row: an absent gateway is undecided, and undecided is reported rather than silently treated as safe.

A row is added only after a run that actually placed an order in the gateway's sandbox. As of the last update that had not happened for any of them, because the blocker SANDBOX-PAYMENT records that no gateway is enabled and no credentials exist in this environment.

The decoration vocabulary lists what the code can withhold TODAY. It grows in the same change that teaches the presentation to withhold another one, because a decoration nobody honours would be a record that reads like a promise.

scenario_vocabulary.sandbox: An order placed in the gateway's sandbox mode completes and the store records it.
scenario_vocabulary.redirect: A gateway that leaves the site and comes back returns to the order it started.
scenario_vocabulary.three_ds: A 3-D Secure challenge is answered and the order is placed afterwards.
scenario_vocabulary.saved_token: A saved token can be reused for a later order by the same customer.
scenario_vocabulary.retry: A refused or abandoned attempt can be tried again without duplicating an order.
scenario_vocabulary.required_data: A flow cannot complete while a field the store requires is unanswered.
scenario_vocabulary.refresh: Changing the country, the shipping method or the payment method refreshes the payment area without losing what was typed.
scenario_vocabulary.express: An express path (wallet, one-click) either satisfies the required fields or is not offered.

decoration_vocabulary.panel: The box this plugin draws around the markup a gateway rendered.

mode_vocabulary.decorated: Every decoration was applied and the scenarios below passed with it.
mode_vocabulary.compatible: A decoration this gateway did not tolerate is recorded in 'withheld' and is not applied.
mode_vocabulary.unavailable: The custom presentation must not offer this gateway at all; the reason is recorded.
mode_vocabulary.undecided: No homologation record exists. Nothing is promised, and the checkout reports this gateway as not homologated.
